revenue.basis: Founder-stated MRR of $29k (~$348k annualized run-rate) in the company's own GitHub README/blog post announcing open-sourcing, dated around Sep 16, 2025.
revenue.quote: As of today, ComfyDeploy is doing $29k MRR, and our last 30 days' revenue was $50k processed. Which is the highest we have ever got, but also the most depressing day I have ever had.

note: Independent YC-backed (S24) startup, founders Nicholas Kao and Benny Kok. In Sep 2025 the founders re-open-sourced the entire ComfyDeploy platform (github.com/comfy-deploy/comfydeploy) after concluding they could not out-compete ComfyOrg's likely cloud offering; the hosted app.comfydeploy.com service is closed to new customers ('no longer taking new customers') but continues to support existing customers. No evidence of any funding round beyond the YC deal itself was found; no acquisition or shutdown has occurred as of the check date.
